# `mise backends ls`

- **Usage:** `mise backends ls`
- **Aliases:** `list`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/backends/ls.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/backends/ls.rs)

List built-in backends

Backends that plugins add are listed by `mise plugins ls`.

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

List the backends built into mise

```

```
